subject: Re: Coordination — Cross-region demo time vs local clock change
messages:
From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@finova.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Riley <tom.riley@finova.com>, Finova Sales Ops <salesops@finova.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Nov 2027 18:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo request — Redwood Dedicated walkthrough

Hi Laura,

Thanks for offering the demo. We have stakeholders in New Zealand (Auckland), Sydney, and our US operations — so we want to lock a single time that works layer-wise. Our initial availability windows are: 8–11am NZDT (Auckland) on Tue/Wed next week, which should translate to US east evening. Can you propose 2 slots and we'll confirm?

Attached a short agenda for context.

Cheers,
Ava
Senior Solutions, Finova

Attachments: Finova_demo_agenda.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:04:00 +1100
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood Dedicated walkthrough

Hi Ava — thanks for the agenda, looks great. Quick note: New Zealand has a DST boundary this coming weekend (clocks go BACK an hour on Sun), while the US switches earlier in November in some states. To avoid any confusion I recommend two narrow options: 2027-11-09 08:30 NZDT (19:30 UTC on 11/08) or 2027-11-10 09:00 NZDT (20:00 UTC on 11/09).

Rishi and Camila — can you confirm we can support a live demo that late in UTC (19:30–20:30 UTC) from our Dedicated env and whether we'd prefer the earlier or the later slot? If the external calendar shows different offsets, we'll send an invite with explicit UTC/Z time labels.

Thanks,
Laura
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_time_slots.ics (calendar, 2 slots)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 09:21:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood Dedicated walkthrough

Laura — quick technical confirm: Dedicated can be live at either 19:30–20:30 UTC or 20:00–21:00 UTC. The only caveat is we'll need to pin the model to a slightly lower batch concurrency for the slot starting at 20:00 UTC due to a maintenance window in eu-west-1 at 21:15 UTC that might add tail latency. I'd prefer the earlier (NZ 08:30) slot to be safe.

Camila — can you add a line about preferred recording and whether we should enable low-latency streaming mode (higher cost) for the region?

-Rishi
SVP, Serving Infrastructure
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2027 22:05:00 +1100
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood Dedicated walkthrough

On Sun, Nov 7, 2027 at 9:21 AM +0530, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Laura — quick technical confirm: Dedicated can be live at either 19:30–20:30 UTC or 20:00–21:00 UTC.
> I'd prefer the earlier (NZ 08:30) slot to be safe.

Agree with earlier slot. From an ops perspective, please mark the calendar invite with explicit offsets (UTC and NZDT/AEDT) and include this sentence in the body: "This event will follow NZ daylight saving time rules; please check your local timezone conversion."

Also recommend we attach a one-slide 'expected experience' doc and record on Zoom; enable the streaming mode for the first 10 minutes to demo interactive latency.

-Camila
Senior Product Solutions Engineer
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@finova.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@finova.com>
Cc: Finova Sales Ops <salesops@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2027 09:03:00 +1300
Subject: Re: Demo request — Redwood Dedicated walkthrough

Thanks everyone — confirming 2027-11-09 08:30 NZDT as final. Our calendar showed a one-hour offset mismatch earlier (our scheduler defaulted to AEDT for Sydney), which caused the confusion. We've accepted the invite and added the Zoom link.

Notes for Redwood team: please send the invite again with both UTC and NZDT timestamps in the title and include a short pre-demo checklist for stakeholders (list of attendees, test audio/video steps). Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Tom Riley
Enterprise GTM, Finova

Forwarded-For-Records: Finova_demo_agenda.pdf (attached), Zoom link https://zoom.us/j/999111222
